title: SSO/KMS Gated Onboarding & Risk Mitigation Checklist for Private Deployments
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Define a gated onboarding playbook and acceptance criteria for Private/VPC customer deployments that require SSO (SAML/OIDC), RBAC, tenant-scoped audit logs, and customer key management (KMS/HSM). This ticket captures: the minimal technical requirements for GA onboarding, a phased scope for lower-risk pilots, mandatory evidence items, a risk mitigation matrix, and a cross-functional sign-off checklist. Scope includes: configuration validation, automated and manual tests, operator runbooks, and evidence packages for compliance reviewers. Out of scope: full air-gapped installer work (separate track), advanced SCIM provisioning features beyond role sync, and HSM procurement/provisioning (infra-led).
acceptance_criteria: SSO: Customer IdP metadata can be uploaded or fetched via URL and validated; SAML assertions are validated against configured certs and audience; OIDC tokens validated for expiry/nonce and issuer claims
SP/IdP metadata roundtrip test documented with replay-proof evidence and example SAML assertion captured in logs (PII scrubbed)

RBAC: Role model and mapping UI supports at least 4 builtin roles (admin, operator, reader, api-client) and allows custom roles with scoped permissions; test matrix covering least-privilege enforcement
Provisioning: SCIM-based user/role sync documented and smoke-tested in a customer pilot (if customer requests); fallback manual mapping documented

Audit logs: All auth events (login, token issue/refresh, role changes, key operations, config changes) are emitted to immutable append-only storage for 365 days by default; exportable evidence package for auditors
KMS/HSM: Customer-managed key import and envelope encryption flow implemented; key usage is recorded in audit logs with key-id, requester, operation (encrypt/decrypt/sign), and timestamp
Key rotation: Rotation can be executed via operator-runbook with automated re-encryption verification and rollback plan; tests include simulated failure and recovery steps
Operational controls: RBAC admin can disable key access for a service principal and trigger an automated alert plus a staged rollback window
E2E tests: Automated CI tests for auth flows and key ops (happy path + 3 failure modes) pass in private-staging environment
Canary criteria: Pilot customer onboarded with canary policy enabled (no more than 3% of production traffic routed) and no P1 incidents during 7 days

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Misconfigured SAML attributes lead to silent auth failures. Mitigation: Add automated validation step that verifies required attributes and surface clear error messages in console and logs.

Risk: Key compromise during import. Mitigation: Enforce in-transit encryption for key import, HSM remote import API usage only, and require multi-person approval for custodian key import in high-risk plans.

Risk: Audit log tampering or accidental retention misconfig. Mitigation: Write-once storage with integrity hashes and periodic integrity checks; include an export with signed digests for customer audits.

Risk: Operational complexity for customers without IdP expertise. Mitigation: Provide an interactive setup wizard, preflight diagnostic checks, and step-by-step troubleshooting guide with example IdP configs.
Risk: HSM availability impacting latency. Mitigation: Use local caching of key-encryption keys and fallback to software-wrapped keys with clear SLA tradeoffs; document expected performance.

Risk: Regulatory variance across regions. Mitigation: Region-aware guidance and gating of certain features (e.g., key export) based on customer jurisdiction; include compliance notes in onboarding checklist.
